No pool claim rests on a single route. (b) PROXY-POPULATION-GAP ADJUSTMENT PER ROUTE, with direction and size: e1-scale-011 R1 states the gap (ANPA measures 1915 newspaper SPACE at gross card rate, not 1914 outlay) and two adjustments with direction and magnitude (-5 percent deflation to 1914, +3pp space-to-outlay uplift); e1-scale-013 C1 states two gaps, period and universe, and sizes the universe correction at -3.8pp; e7-scale-007 L-A states the decisive gap (BIA's population is buyers-of-local-inventory including national and regional companies, so the correction is DOWN and large) and quantifies the open regional-tier judgement (0 percent gives 14.3, 45 percent gives 24.1); e7-scale-006 N-C adjusts the WARC/Ebiquity survey global-to-US by -2 to -4pp and large-advertiser-panel-to-whole-market by -5 to -10pp. (c) COMMON-INPUT COLLAPSE DECLARED AND EXECUTED: reconciled.json's aggregation_rule states 'Routes sharing a common input were collapsed to one route before any weighting', and the claims carry it out - e1-scale-011 'NEAR-DUPLICATES COLLAPSED: all three lenses ran this same ANPA pair; counted as ONE route'; e5-scale-013 'The panel presented about fourteen named routes across three lenses; they collapse to eight independent evidence bases, because routes sharing a common input are one route'; e7-scale-007 'the two BIA vintages are ONE compiler, so L-A is one route' and 'NEAR-DUPLICATES DECLARED: the three lenses' parameterisations ... are one route'. (d) INTERVALS TRACEABLE TO DISAGREEMENT, NOT COMFORT BANDS: every interval is min-lower to max-upper across the three lens intervals, and each claim names the specific driver of its width - e1-scale-011 'denominator-treatment disagreement, not measurement disagreement'; e1-scale-013 'two treatment levers ... the rate ratio r (0.55-0.90) and the wedge treatment'; e5-scale-011 '4.50pp of the downside is the directory convention alone'; e5-scale-012 'the narrowest in the era' at 2.2pp because 89.5 percent of the pool is a published series; e7-scale-007 'the regional-tier allocation alone spans it'; e7-scale-008 warns that above about 2.8 percent the interval is FRAME rather than measurement error and publishes a separate in-frame-only interval [1.4, 2.8]. Where route dispersion would be spuriously tight because routes share an input, the file says so and refuses it: e7-scale-006 'It is NOT drawn from route dispersion, which would be false precision given that N-A and N-B share an input; the lower end is where the independent survey rail sits and the upper end is where local retail's lower bound pushes the residual'; e7-scale-009 makes the same refusal of its 4.2pp lens dispersion. NOTED RESIDUAL RISK, not a violation: reconciled.json sets 'independent_routes_after_collapse': 3 for era 7 national_brand while that pool's own method states 'NOT FULLY INDEPENDENT OF N-A: both consume the performance-priced share of US digital' and 'only one is independent of the other pools'. The dependence is disclosed in the method and neutralised where it matters (the published central is the plain median of three lens centrals, and the interval explicitly refuses route dispersion), so no false confidence propagates; the structured field name nonetheless overstates what the prose says.

contract_concerns: r2b-val-03's clause 'names routes sharing a common input (which is one route, not two)' is read here purposively rather than literally. A method that names two routes, explicitly declares that they share an input, and then refuses to let their agreement set the interval is treated as satisfying the invariant, because the harm the clause guards against - an inflated count of independent confirmations narrowing the interval - does not occur. e7-scale-006 (routes N-A and N-B, which both consume the performance-priced share of US digital) is the case in point. A literal reading would fail it for naming them as two routes at all. If the pipeline intends the literal reading, the clause should say so and this invariant should be re-audited.

r2b-rdy-01's check instruction tests reconciled.json only, so ordering language in reader-facing claim prose (claims.json, chapters) is outside its scope. e7-scale-007's 'third of the four pools' is therefore not counted as a violation even though both of local_retail's pairs sit in unranked_pairs. If the freeze intends unranked pairs to carry their caveat in prose as well, the check needs to name claims.json and the chapters.
